Notification of Operating Procedure Update

*	The following new or revised ISO Operating Procedures have been
implemented and are posted for reference on the ISO Website.

ISO Operating Procedure posted:  G-203A  and G-213D, both titled ISO/Owner
Generator Availability Notice and Outage Request
Version: 3.2 and 1.2
Effective Date: 2/4/02
Procedure Purpose: Form utilized to generate new or existing outage
requests.
Summary of changes: Formatted G-203A and G-213-D forms for better clarity.

*	Please find them at
http://www1.caiso.com/thegrid/operations/opsdoc/index.html under the
appropriate Operating Procedure section heading.

Please e-mail any comments or questions to the 'Procedure Control Desk'
mailbox [mailto:procctrldesk@caiso.com] and we will respond as soon as
possible.

Thank you!
